# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/).

## In short

- Be respectful and constructive. Critique code, not people.
- No harassment, insults, discriminatory language, or unwelcome attention.
- No publishing other people's private information without permission.

## Scope

Applies to all project spaces: issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other place where you represent the project.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to singhalutkarsh26@gmail.com. Reports are reviewed promptly and kept confidential. The maintainer may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, issues, and other contributions that break this code, and may temporarily or permanently ban contributors who do so.
